frame.replay: cold from 2006, a week at a time: every game of a week projected before any of it is absorbed; the market never enters a projection
frame.caveat: The engines’ linear weights and residual tables were fitted through 2025: on 2016–2025 they are partly in-sample (the replay rebuilds team state, not weights), which favours the ENGINE candidate. The 2026 season is out of sample for everything.

rules.score: mean multinomial log loss over win / push / lose events anchored on the engine’s own rounded number
rules.selection: lowest selection-window log loss; the incumbent ENGINE is kept unless beaten by at least 0.001 nats
rules.note: Written into the tool before any score was read. Confirmation and live windows are reported, never used to choose.

qb_layer.question: with the listed starters absorbed into the engine’s quarterback layer, are the projections and the shipped ENGINE probabilities any closer to the outcomes?
qb_layer.scenario_basis: nflverse records the starting quarterback after the game and carries no announcement time. A replay that reads this archive measures the quarterback layer as if the starter were known; it does not certify that he was known before kickoff.

arms.off: no quarterback starts absorbed, as the live board runs (every other number in this file)
arms.on: the listed starter of each side absorbed with his pass deviation

qb_layer.verdict_text: no different: none of the paired held-out comparisons moved by a distinguishable margin
